description: Sets the x-axis values from the specified range to the specified series. It is used with the scatter charts only.

params.description: A range of cells from the sheet with series x-axis values. For example:"'sheet 1'!$A$2:$A$5" - must be a single cell, row or column,"A1:A5" - must be a single cell, row or column,"Example series".
params.name: sRange

params.description: The index of the chart series.
params.name: nSeria
